description: This file contains utility functions for handling and evaluating license information in the Mattermost application, including license expiration, type checks, and license tier assessments.

methods.name: isLicenseExpiring
methods.description: Checks if a license is nearing expiration within a 60-day notification window, excluding cloud licenses.

methods.name: daysToLicenseExpire
methods.description: Calculates the number of days until a license expires, if applicable.

methods.name: isLicenseExpired
methods.description: Determines if a license has already expired.

methods.name: isLicensePastGracePeriod
methods.description: Checks if the license has exceeded the grace period after expiration.

methods.name: isTrialLicense
methods.description: Identifies if a license is a trial license based on its duration.

methods.name: isCloudLicense
methods.description: Checks if a license is a cloud license.

methods.name: getIsStarterLicense
methods.description: Checks if a license is a starter license.

methods.name: getIsGovSku
methods.description: Checks if a license is a government SKU.

methods.name: isEnterpriseLicense
methods.description: Determines if a license is an enterprise license based on its SKU.

methods.name: isNonEnterpriseLicense
methods.description: Determines if a license is not an enterprise license.

methods.name: licenseSKUWithFirstLetterCapitalized
methods.description: Returns the license SKU with the first letter capitalized.

methods.name: isEnterpriseOrCloudOrSKUStarterFree
methods.description: Checks if the license qualifies as enterprise, cloud starter free, or self-hosted starter.

methods.name: isMinimumProfessionalLicense
methods.description: Checks if the license meets the minimum professional tier.

methods.name: isMinimumEnterpriseLicense
methods.description: Checks if the license meets the minimum enterprise tier.

methods.name: isMinimumEnterpriseAdvancedLicense
methods.description: Checks if the license meets the minimum enterprise advanced tier.
